thread:
Mina (product): quick sync on the trace viewer tweaks before we freeze for the next release. main asks: make correlation id easier to copy, add a print-friendly view for postmortems, and make external frames collapsible by default. dropping the mock here: https://redwood.mock/trace-print. would love layout + a11y feedback.
Luca (design): i pushed a variant that shows a persistent top bar with the request metadata + a small Copy chip for the correlation id. Print view is a separate route (`/trace/:id/print`) with simplified styles (no avatars, single-column). question: should the copy chip say 'Copy id' or 'Copy request id'? which is clearer for support docs? :thinking: 
Taylor (frontend): 'Copy request id' matches existing docs. for keyboard support, make the chip a native button with `tabindex=0` and `aria-label="Copy request id"`. also recommend a keyboard shortcut (Shift+C) to copy the id when focus is in the trace view. will add `preventDefault` for the shortcut.
Priya (eng): implementation note: print view should inline critical CSS and avoid lazy frames so the printed PDF contains the full stack. but full traces can be huge  for print we should cap at top 200 frames and show "+N frames omitted". backend can provide `?print=true&max_frames=200`.
Ana (accessibility): a11y checklist: (1) copy success must be announced via a live region (`role="status"`), (2) the collapsed-frame chevrons need 44px tap targets on mobile, (3) contrast: module labels currently #9ca3af which is borderline; bump to #6b7280. also ensure print view has sufficient color contrast when printing in greyscale.
Luca (design): good catches. i'll make chevrons larger and update the color tokens. also adding an affordance: group-by-module toggle so users can collapse all external libraries at once (default collapsed). suggestion: small inline label "Hide third-party frames" with a toggle.
Mina (product): grouping sounds great. also let's add a permalink copy action (Copy share link) that generates a short-lived view token for debugging teams so they can hand off traces without sharing full org data. TTL 24h?
Priya (eng): short-lived token is doable. backend API: `POST /traces/:id/share { ttl_hours: 24 }` returns `{ share_url }`. will log share events to audit. security: make default TTL 1 hour and allow up to 24 via param.
Taylor (frontend): for the share action, show a tooltip with the url and a copy button. aria: announce when link created. UX: confirm before generating if trace contains PII (we'll detect bodies with email patterns and show warning).
Ana (accessibility): for the share flow, the modal that displays the link must trap focus and return focus to the original trigger on close. also include a visible focus outline for the copy button.
Luca (design): print layout question: should stack frames show full file paths or truncated with ellipses? for print we probably want full paths, but that can wrap awkwardly. option: show filename bold and path on the next line in smaller type.
Mina (product): prefer filename prominent + wrapped path underneath for print. also change microcopy: 'Download trace (JSON)' on the header action and a secondary 'Print-friendly' link. keep both.
Taylor (frontend): will wire up both. for the 'Download trace' flow, add a server-side streamed response (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) to avoid memory spikes. fallback to trimmed if size > 8MB with message: "Large trace trimmed for download".
Priya (eng): agreed on streaming. for trimming algorithm: drop repeated identical frames and truncate long headers/bodies. will include a small manifest in the JSON header: `"_trimmed": true, "original_frames": 12344`.
ux-bot: reminder: design token `--chip-focus-ring` updated in staging (build 4310).
Ana (accessibility): also run through NVDA/VoiceOver quick checks after PR merged. print view: include skip links at top for screen readers so they can jump to metadata or stack.
Luca (design): i'll post updated PNGs with the persistent top bar, larger chevrons, and the print layout variant by EOD.
Mina (product): timeline: Luca updates mock, Taylor picks up keyboard & live region changes, Priya builds share endpoint and streaming. target canary next Thu. thanks all. :heart:
